distribution.name: change_voxel_stats_MLS.xlsx
distribution.description: Results of the applied change-detection algorithm between before- and after-harvest point clouds of MLS scans. Plot = Plot number, voxel_size = applied voxel size to detect change, voxel_count_before = number of voxels counted in before harvest scan, voxel_count_after = number of voxels counted in after harvest scan, voxel_only_in_before = number of voxels unique to the before harvest scan

distribution.name: change_voxel_stats_UAV.xlsx
distribution.description: Results of the applied change-detection algorithm between before- and after-harvest point clouds of UAV scans. Plot = Plot number, voxel_size = applied voxel size to detect change, voxel_count_before = number of voxels counted in before harvest scan, voxel_count_after = number of voxels counted in after harvest scan, voxel_only_in_before = number of voxels unique to the before harvest scan

distribution.name: lidar_scans_clipped_plots_UAV_MLS.zip
distribution.description: Processed and clipped before- and after-harvest point clouds of all plots captured by MLS and UAV-LS.

distribution.name: refined_voxel_stats_0.08m_zcut1.00m.tab
distribution.description: Results of the refined harvest voxel algorithm on MLS data (voxel size: 8 cm, z-cutoff: 1 m). Plot = plot number, harvest_voxel = voxel size used in change-detection algorithm, voxel_count = number of voxels after refinement.
